prompts.name: messy-data-investment-case
prompts.prompt: Build the decision model for this internal investment case before writing any deck copy. Facts and estimates: annual software hosting/support is expected to be AED 120,000, sourced from the current run-cost estimate. A Commercial proxy values productive vessel time at AED 12,000 per hour; Finance has not yet approved that measure. DOME data are incomplete, but two recent projects recorded 18 and 31 GNSS-affected productive hours. A technical lead estimates the wider mitigation programme recovers about 30% of GNSS-affected time; this includes antennas, procedures and software, so Holocron's share is unknown. Options are hold current state, controlled expansion, or a bounded regional pilot. Build credible low/base/high cases, show break-even and a switching value, and identify what the pilot should measure. Do not choose assumptions merely to make the pilot positive.
assertions: Uses labelled assumptions and proxies instead of waiting for perfect data
Builds low, base and high cases from credible adverse, best-current and favourable assumptions
Calculates the protected hours required to cover the AED 120,000 incremental cost
Shows at least one switching value tied to a decision-driving assumption
Keeps the 30% programme recovery separate from Holocron attribution
Frames the pilot as validation of decision-driving assumptions rather than discovery of value from zero
